notes: Hase is a German maker; the src page is the EU/English site and gives only a EUR price (from 5.999). No US class, top speed or range published by the maker. New Atlas covers the launch version (Shimano E6100, 504 Wh), so it is used only for specs that don't depend on the drive system (load total, telescoping frame) plus its 25 km/h EU speed; its older motor/battery figures were not recorded. Frame telescopes (shortens), it doesn't fold. The maker's 'Maximum load 200 kg' is a total incl. rider per New Atlas.
